subject.title: [Feature]: Console-free windows dashboard autostart (also without duplicate gateway launch)

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in native Windows dashboard opener task to managed gateway/onboarding, and which UX/security/lifecycle contract should own it?
rationale: This is not a broken existing contract; it adds new Windows logon behavior, browser launching, and cleanup responsibilities in setup code, which automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded core opener
options.body: Add an explicit Windows setup option that creates a separate opener-only task with uninstall/doctor cleanup and live Windows proof.

options.title: Defer to companion app
options.body: Keep CLI setup unchanged and revisit automatic dashboard launch when a native Windows companion app owns startup UI behavior.

options.title: Decline dashboard autostart
options.body: Keep Control UI opening manual or bookmark-based to avoid adding browser-launching startup behavior to core setup.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded core opener
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Windows setup option that creates a separate opener-only task with uninstall/doctor cleanup and live Windows proof.
